coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of five ground-truth variable items match (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware resources, inclusion of MAPPO and QMIX as algorithm conditions, and training time to a defined convergence threshold.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design selects six maps rather than nine and includes maps exceeding the 10-unit restriction. Its normalized score subtracts a random-policy baseline instead of simply dividing the algorithm score by the scenario maximum. It also adds IPPO and VDN beyond the specified algorithm conditions.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It omits both expected findings: PPO trains 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios because of greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
